EMS cloud optimizes charging and discharging based on electricity prices, irradiance forecasts and your household\'s consumption habits.
Solar power supplies household loads first, surplus charges the battery, and only when the battery is full is power exported to the grid. In the evening the battery discharges to supply loads.
The system charges and discharges the battery in the configured time slots to reduce costs under the electricity tariff (off-peak, normal, peak).
Solar power is exported to the grid first; household loads and the battery use the rest. Only use with a power sale agreement.
Solar power fully charges the battery first, then supplies loads; any shortfall comes from the grid. Suited to the rainy season or before a storm.
The battery always keeps at least %1$s to supply power during a grid outage.
The battery always keeps at least %1$s to supply power during a grid outage, enough for about ~%2$s h of essential loads.

resources.string: Each strategy is a set of charge/discharge slots applied to the days you choose. Each day belongs to only one strategy; unassigned days run as Max self-consumption.
Up to 4 strategies. Tap a strategy to view and edit its time slots.
At the start of each day, the system loads the matching strategy\'s time slots into the inverter.
Charge and discharge slots of this strategy. Outside these slots, the system runs as Max self-consumption.
%1$s. Selecting these days moves them to the strategy being edited.
